run_training_graph_optimizer_scheduler: run the Scheduler on a graph with gradients to compute an optimal schedule under a memory limit
test_compute_optimal_schedule: test ComputeOptimalSchedule with a memory limit of 1209 and swapping enabled to verify peak memory usage
validate_address_allocation: validate the memory address allocation returned by the scheduler using utils.validate_address_allocation
validate_timeline: validate the scheduling timeline returned by the scheduler using utils.validate_timeline
check_graph_consistency: check graph consistency and validity before running the training graph optimizer scheduler
